Contributor: infeeeee Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Ahoj! Welcome to Hungary! Please use English changeset comments when you work internationally. Have you been inside the workshop? How do you now the position of tracks inside the building? it's not visible on Esri imagery. Also in Hungary please align Esri to the local FÖMI 2011-2014 imagery first, it's old but it's very accurate. Tram tracks don't change that frequently. Here the offset between the two imagery is around 5 m. Please contact the Hungarian community if you have a question, you can find our channels here: https://openstreetmap.community/?map=47.41333,19.03003&zoom=6.55 Date: 2025-01-22T17:51:26+01:00
